description: This file implements a TCP connector for a host environment, managing socket connections, data transfer between FIFOs and sockets, and logging. It includes functions for opening sockets, dumping packet data, and main logic for handling data transfer in separate threads.

methods.name: OpenSocket
methods.description: Attempts to open a local socket connection by port or path, retrying until successful.

methods.name: DumpPackets
methods.description: Logs the contents of a buffer in hexadecimal format up to a specified size.

methods.name: TcpConnectorMain
methods.description: Main function that sets up socket connections, manages data transfer threads, and handles command-line arguments.
